name: Bellevue Apartments
accommodation: Bellevue Apartments and Bellevue Luxe, plus six bookable rooms
confirmedFeatures: Free Wi-Fi, toiletries, washer and dryer in each apartment
overview: Serviced apartments in a historic building on Redcar seafront, with standard and Luxe apartments as well as six rooms. Each apartment has its own washer and dryer. Its seafront position puts the beach a short walk away.
surfTripFit: An in-apartment washer-dryer is handy for wetsuits and towels, and the building is on the seafront.
